UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated researcher user profile for Google, ORCID, or Email sign-in.

uid.description: Unique user identifier matching Firebase Auth UID or canonical orcid_<digits>.

provider.description: Authentication provider used (google, orcid, or email).

emailOrId.description: Primary identifier displayed in profile UI (email or ORCID iD).

orcidId.description: Unique canonical ORCID iD bound to this account.

verified.description: True when identity was verified via official ORCID OAuth or verified provider.

photoURL.description: User profile picture URL or data URI.

scholarUrl.description: Optional Google Scholar profile link for the researcher.

scholarUserId.description: Optional extracted Google Scholar user ID.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when user profile was last updated.

ScholarClaim.title: ScholarClaim
ScholarClaim.description: 1-to-1 authoritative binding of a verified Google Scholar profile to an authenticated ORCID/Google account.

claimedByUid.description: UID of the authentic user account.

ExportRecord.title: ExportRecord
ExportRecord.description: Record of a PDF or PNG export generated by an authenticated user.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who generated the export.

scholarName.description: Name of the analyzed researcher profile.

exportType.description: Type of export generated (pdf or png).

targetName.description: Name of the exported chart or report.

OrcidAccount.title: OrcidAccount
OrcidAccount.description: Enforces strict 1-to-1 unique constraint mapping each canonical ORCID iD to a single ScholarLens account UID.

uid.description: The single owning ScholarLens user UID bound to this ORCID iD.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when ORCID binding was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when ORCID binding was last refreshed.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores researcher user profile keyed by user UID.

/orcidAccounts/{orcidId}.description: Authoritative 1-to-1 unique constraint index binding each ORCID iD to exactly one account UID.

/scholarClaims/{scholarUserId}.description: Enforces 1-to-1 unique lock preventing multiple accounts from claiming the same Google Scholar profile.

/exports/{exportId}.description: Stores export activity records owned by authenticated researchers.
